title: Hold an authorisation for anatomical examination
what: Undertake anatomical examinations only under an authorisation, on bodies released by the Head of Faculty.

sources.title: Anatomical Examinations Act 2006 (Tas)
sources.quote: A person must not undertake an anatomical examination unless – (a) the person holds an individual authorisation and the body being anatomically examined has been released to the person by the Head of Faculty in accordance with this Act;

administration.who: Secretary of the Department administering the Anatomical Examinations Act 2006 (Tas)
